source: https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices captured 2026-08-21 (productName 'Azure OpenAI GPT5', serviceName 'Foundry Models'): the '5.6 sol' meters price, per 1M tokens, standard-tier input at $5.00 (ShortCo Global), $5.50 (ShortCo Data Zone), $10.00 (LongCo Global) and $11.00 (LongCo Data Zone), with output at $30.00, $33.00, $45.00 and $49.50 respectively. Recorded here are the LongCo Data Zone rates, the highest standard-tier pair. Data Zone because the deployment scope is chosen by AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT and the adapter cannot know which applies; LongCo because the price list does not state the context-tier boundary, so it cannot be ruled out at this budget's 20000-token input cap. The priority-processing meters ($11.00/$66.00) never apply: the adapter requests no service tier.
